thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Brightway needs a short UAT egress surge for a partner demo Wed 16:00-20:00 PST. They asked for IP allowlist + a soft QPS bump (30 -> 120 rps) on the us-west-2-uat peering. Renewal convo mid-April, demo high-stakes. Can ops do a temporary handoff for this window? cidrs provided: 203.0.113.0/24 :eyes:
Sam Ortiz: Confirming region = us-west-2-uat. Need to check edge-nat pool and concurrent conn capacity. 120 rps for 4h sounds doable as soft bump if we set autorevoke. Can you confirm start/end in UTC?
Maya Chen: Window: 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z. Also add note to account about renewal risk and CS will capture latency pre/post.
Priya Nair: For peering we need peer-id and whether they originate from a fixed NAT. Also: using mTLS or standard HTTPS? If NATed behind our edge, we'll expand peering ACL and whitelist the /24.
Devin Ramos: Quick config snippet we can push as temp policy:
```
policy: temp_qps_override
scope: customer:brightway, region:us-west-2-uat
qps: 120
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
autorevoke: 48h
reason: partner demo requested by CSM Maya Chen
```
Sam Ortiz: Implementation notes: set a soft limit (nginx token bucket) so we don't hard-block other traffic. I'll validate NAT pool capacity and apply ACL to uat-egress route table. If edge-nat full we'll fallback to token-throttling and notify.
Priya Nair: Peer-id = brt-001, they confirmed origin IPs static, no mTLS, standard TLS. I'll add the CIDR to ACL. DO NOT apply to prod or service-tokens group.
Liam Park: Commercial note — Brightway renewal 2026-04-15. Smooth demo materially affects NRR. Appreciate 48h autorevoke. Can CS get a simple latency delta after the demo to attach to renewal playbook?
Maya Chen: Yes — I'll run 10 pre/demo prompts and 10 post-demo prompts with same seeds and paste results here. Ops, please timestamp when change goes live so I can align tests.
Sam Ortiz: Plan: 1) apply allowlist + route change at 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z, 2) flip soft qps to 120, 3) monitor 5m for anomalies, 4) send go/no-go. If OK, keep until 48h autorevoke unless Maya requests earlier revoke.
deploy-bot: policy-change: temp_qps_override applied to customer:brightway region:us-west-2-uat at 2026-04-01T23:00:37Z by ops/sam. ACL brt-001 -> 203.0.113.0/24 added. Autorevoke scheduled in 48h.
Devin Ramos: Troubleshooting pointers for CS: if demo shows 429s, check token header X-Redwood-QPS and edge logs at /var/log/edge/us-west-2-uat/access.log. Example: `grep 203.0.113. /var/log/edge/us-west-2-uat/access.log | grep 429`
Maya Chen: Got it — thanks. I'll post latency samples after demo. Noting in account: "demo allowlist + 120rps soft bump, auto-revoke 48h, renewal 2026-04-15"
Sam Ortiz: Closing loop: applied and monitoring. Will post short ops summary after revoke. :white_check_mark:
